title: Currency identities jodo
instruction: Har currency ko uske description partner se jodo. Sirf symbol mat dekho: Yen aur Yuan dono ke liye ¥ diya hai.

places.label: Sabse widely held aur traded globally
Book: EU ke 27 mein se 20 states
Trade aur reserves mein badhta role

pieces.label: $ | United States Dollar | USD
pieces.right: Book USD ko globally sabse widely held aur traded fiat currency batati hai.
pieces.wrong: USD ka profile global holding aur trading wala hai; doosri identity jodne se currency profile badal jaayegi.

pieces.label: € | Euro | EUR
pieces.right: Book Euro ko 27 EU members mein se 20 se jodti hai. 'Second-most' ke baad caption incomplete hai; ranking guess nahi karenge.
pieces.wrong: EU adoption wala description Euro ka hai; national currency se jodne se geography aur identity bigadti hain.

pieces.label: ¥ | Japanese Yen | JPY
pieces.right: JPY ke saath stability aur global currency markets mein major role wala description juda.
pieces.wrong: ¥ dekhkar CNY ka partner mat lagao: Japanese Yen ka code JPY aur book ka profile stability wala hai.

pieces.label: £ | British Pound Sterling | GBP
pieces.right: Book pound ko oldest fiat currency still in use kehti hai aur history 8th century se jodti hai. Isse modern fiat regime ki starting date mat samjho.
pieces.wrong: Historical continuity ko doosri currency se jodne se oldest-currency claim galat identity par lag jaayega.

pieces.label: ¥ | Chinese Yuan Renminbi | CNY
pieces.right: CNY ka profile global trade aur international reserves mein badhte influence ka hai.
pieces.wrong: ¥ shared symbol hai, shared identity nahi. Yen ka stability profile lagaane se CNY ka distinction kho jaayega.

win: Paanch identities aur profiles jud gayin; shared ¥ se confusion nahi hua.
